text:
rachel_csm: Heads up — Innovara pinged us asking for an APAC allowlist + temporary rate bump for a pilot next Tue. Onboarding has slipped and they're worried this will impact renewal.

maria_cs: Do they have CIDRs and the exact QPS target? Any compliance notes?

rachel_csm: They sent these: `203.0.113.0/24`, `198.51.100.32/28`. Target region: `ap-southeast-1`.
They're asking to go from ~50 QPS -> 200 QPS for ~72h (demo traffic). Quote from PM: "need headroom for live demo, otherwise we'll cancel the pilot".

alex_infra: I can apply the CIDRs to peering allowlist but need a ticket and security sign-off. Temporary rate window is doable — can provision 200 QPS for 72h. ETA ~2h after ticket.

tony_ops: I'll set a 30m enablement call with their infra team Tue 10:00 AEST. @rachel_csm can you add agenda (billing, rate limits, monitoring)? :+1:

rachel_csm: Invite sent. Also flagged renewal as "at-risk" in our tracker (renewal in 3 weeks). Adding enablement + demo success metrics to mitigation plan.

simon_eng: Suggest routing the pilot traffic to a canary pool in APAC: `route=apac-canary -> model=redwood-v1-lite` and keep fallback to `redwood-v1`. Rollout policy: `if 95p latency > 300ms -> fallback`. Limits risk while giving headroom.

maria_cs: Noted customer feedback: they want a transparent cost estimate for short burst windows. We should send a simple calc + example invoice impact.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued by alex_infra: peering-allowlist-update for `203.0.113.0/24`, `198.51.100.32/28` (job id: job-9087) at 3412347000.

alex_infra: Created ticket CS-4521 — applied allowlist and opened temp rate window (200 QPS) for 72h. Will monitor and revert automatically. Posting metrics once live.

rachel_csm: Great — tracking this in the renewal spreadsheet and CS playbook. If pilot goes well we'll propose a follow-up SLO review + committed capacity conversation. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
